project_name.justification: The documents consistently refer to the project as the ML Property. For example: "Prospector to Acquire ML Property, Yukon" and "the closing of its previously announced acquisition of the ML Property (also known as the Mike Lake Property)".

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified at the beginning of each press release: "Prospector Metals Corp. (TSXV: PPP) ... is pleased to announce that it has entered into a property purchase agreement to acquire a 100% interest in the ML Property".

ceo_buyer.justification: The press releases are signed by 'Dr. Rob Carpenter, Ph.D., P.Geo. President & CEO' on behalf of Prospector Metals Corp.

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The text states that Prospector Metals Corp. will "acquire a 100% interest in the ML Property".

primary_commodity.justification: The property is described as being within the "prolific Tintina Gold Belt" and target types include "intrusion related gold, gold-copper-tungsten skarn, high grade vein, and replacement Au-Ag mineralization".

verified_article_link.justification: The article titled "Prospector to Acquire ML Property, Yukon" directly concerns the acquisition of the ML project by Prospector Metals Corp., which is the subject of this analysis.

currency.justification: The acquiring company, Prospector Metals Corp., is listed on the TSX Venture Exchange (TSXV: PPP) and the private placement offerings are priced in dollars ($). This context implies the currency is Canadian Dollars (CAD).

cash_payments_raw.justification: The transaction is described as a "shares-only purchase agreement". A future milestone payment of $1-2 million is mentioned, but it is contingent upon a future resource estimate and can be paid in shares, so it is not included as an upfront cash payment. The primary consideration is shares, following Priority 2 of the financial extraction hierarchy.

share_payments_raw.justification: Following the financial data extraction hierarchy, Priority 2 (amount of shares and price per share) is used because both components are available, so this field for a single raw share value is null.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: Following the financial data extraction hierarchy, Priority 2 (amount of shares and price per share) is used, so this field for a combined value is null.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The closing announcement states: "Pursuant to the Transaction, the Company issued 9,222,164 common shares of the Company (the 'Common Shares') to Troilus".

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: No warrants were issued to the seller, Troilus Gold Corporation, as part of the acquisition consideration. Warrants mentioned in the text are part of a separate private placement financing.

option_payments_raw.justification: No options were mentioned as part of the acquisition consideration.

issued_share_price.justification: The transaction terms mention the number of shares issued (9,222,164), but not an explicit price for the acquisition shares. Using the last traded price as a fallback per the rules, as seen in the detailed quote: 'Last: 0.21'.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The agreement does not specify an exploration commitment in terms of drilling meters.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The agreement does not contain a specific exploration spending commitment to the seller. The company states an intention to use proceeds from a separate private placement for work on the ML Property, but this is not a contractual commitment as part of the acquisition terms.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: The transaction terms described in the documents do not mention the acquisition or retention of a Net Smelter Royalty (NSR).

coverage_area_raw.justification: The text states: "The ML Property encompasses 4,757 hectares within the prolific Tintina Gold Belt".

coverage_area_unit.justification: The text states: "The ML Property encompasses 4,757 hectares within the prolific Tintina Gold Belt".

resource_size.justification: The text does not state a current mineral resource estimate. A milestone payment is contingent on the future "completion of a mineral resource estimate", which implies one does not currently exist.

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The buyer is identified as "Prospector Metals Corp. (TSXV: PPP) (OTCQB: ETHOF) (FSE: 1ET)". The primary listing is TSXV:PPP.
